label: Valio lactose-free milk
note: The first fully lactose-free milk, launched in September 2001 as a "light milk drink" because it could not be called milk; made by taking the lactose out with membranes rather than only by lactase (how exactly is disputed between sources)

about.text: Milk from the Finnish dairy cooperative Valio with the lactose removed, developed in 2001 and called the first totally lactose-free milk in the world. Unlike milk treated only with lactase it does not taste sweet.

links.name: Valio: pioneer in lactose free dairy

how.text: The lactose is taken out of the milk physically, not split in it, so the milk keeps its ordinary taste. How exactly this is done is not stated on Valio own pages.
how.label: take the lactose out
